findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "network-exposure" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: network-exposure_ip-list-diff, network-exposure_csr-decode-validate, network-exposure_dnssec-validate-offline · Private data: network-exposure_ssh-key-audit · Public sink: network-exposure_cidr-calculate, network-exposure_ip-list-diff, network-exposure_service-banner-fingerprint, network-exposure_cpe-parse-match, network-exposure_cvss-calculate, network-exposure_tls-fingerprint-compute, network-exposure_x509-decode, network-exposure_csr-decode-validate, network-exposure_certificate-chain-build, network-exposure_ssh-key-audit, network-exposure_nmap-xml-summarize, network-exposure_port-service-risk-classify, network-exposure_firewall-rule-analyze, network-exposure_dns-zone-audit, network-exposure_dnssec-validate-offline · Destructive: network-exposure_cidr-calculate, network-exposure_ip-list-diff, network-exposure_service-banner-fingerprint, network-exposure_cpe-parse-match, network-exposure_cvss-calculate, network-exposure_tls-fingerprint-compute, network-exposure_x509-decode, network-exposure_csr-decode-validate, network-exposure_certificate-chain-build, network-exposure_ssh-key-audit, network-exposure_nmap-xml-summarize, network-exposure_port-service-risk-classify, network-exposure_firewall-rule-analyze, network-exposure_dns-zone-audit, network-exposure_dnssec-validate-offline.
